deck: BUY VACANT PARCELS FROM APATHETIC OWNERS AT A DEEP DISCOUNT AND RESELL NEAR MARKET
SCRUBBED COUNTY LISTS, HAND-COMPED OFFERS, AND MAIL, TEXT, AND CALL VOLUME THAT CLOSES DEALS
site_ui.lead: Land flippers buy vacant parcels from apathetic, free-and-clear owners at a deep discount, verify perc, access, and flood risk, and resell to builders, investors, or retail buyers, with texting and direct mail feeding the pipeline at a reported 3x to 23x return on ad spend.
site_ui.summary: All 12 chapters synthesize 192 verbatim YouTube practitioner testimonies covering the full land flipping cycle, from market selection and list building through due diligence, subdividing, title, selling, and alternative land uses. Every metric, pro-tip, operator gate, and quote carries timestamped inline attribution to the practitioner channel and video it came from.
chapters: Direct Mail Campaigns for Vacant Land
Cold Calling, Texting, and Multichannel Deal Acquisition
Due Diligence: Perc Tests, Septic, and Site Checks
Selling Land: Buyers, Seller Financing, and Drone Media
Alternative Land Uses: RV Parks, Solar, and Battery Storage
flow: Target counties with at least 200 land sales a year, days on market under 90 to 120, and fewer active listings than sold listings.
Pull free-and-clear, inherited, or absentee owners, then strip the 40% to 50% of parcels with wetlands, flood, slope, or bad access and the garbage records.
Hand-comp acreage bands from median price per acre minus agent, closing, and lender costs, and never let software auto-price the offers.
Send priced mailers at roughly 58 to 69 cents a piece, short texts near 100 characters, and cold calls, then remail and keep working stale leads.
Confirm soil and septic where there is no city sewer, legal deeded access, and flood status, extending inspection 30 to 45 days before earnest money goes hard.
Resell to builders, investors, or retail buyers, or subdivide to manufacture margin, because the deal picks the exit.
